source_species_detail: C57BL/6J T9 70-kdyn contusion; primary P1-P3 astrocytes; collagen-I-induced scar-forming astrocytes
source_scope: SCI plus in-vitro astrocyte model
assay_or_perturbation: collagen-I induction/removal; anti-beta1-integrin and anti-N-cadherin blockade; astrocyte transplantation; GFAP/N-cadherin immunostaining and qPCR
citation_note: Tamaru et al. 2023; primary SCI and astrocyte experiments
evidence_summary: Collagen-I-associated astrocyte state and beta1-integrin/N-cadherin blockade altered scar-forming phenotype and host-astrocyte recruitment.
limitations: No purified ligand-binding, occupancy, force, or FAK/SRC phosphorylation assay; antibody blockade is not a receptor-specific genetic test.

source_species_detail: Female C57BL/6 T11 100-kdyn contusion; primary mouse and hESC-derived human astrocytes
source_scope: SCI tissue plus stiffness-controlled astrocyte cultures
assay_or_perturbation: AFM stiffness mapping; 200-versus-2000-Pa substrates; beta1-integrin/ILK, actin, GFAP, morphology, and process-complexity readouts; IMP treatment
citation_note: Cooper et al. 2020; chronic stiffness and astrocyte substrate experiments
evidence_summary: Substrate stiffness altered astrocyte morphology, actin organization, GFAP/process complexity, and beta1-integrin/ILK-associated responses; IMP reduced fibrotic stiffness in vivo.
limitations: No direct matrix-receptor binding or definitive FAK/SRC activation test; substrate stiffness is not equivalent to native ECM composition; IMP is broadly immunomodulatory.

source_species_detail: Female C57BL/6 T11 contusion; chronic lesion core/rim
source_scope: SCI tissue mechanics and lesion architecture
assay_or_perturbation: AFM stiffness mapping; fibronectin/GFAP immunohistochemistry; CurveAlign; IMP treatment
pathway_or_branch: chronic lesion stiffness to fibronectin/GFAP architecture
citation_note: Cooper et al. 2020; chronic lesion mechanics
evidence_summary: Chronic lesion stiffness was associated with fibronectin/GFAP architecture and glial-fiber alignment; IMP altered lesion stiffness and scar architecture.
limitations: Association and broad treatment effects do not identify a unique receptor-proximal mechanism or TF endpoint.

source_species_detail: C57BL/6 T11 70-kdyn contusion; FnEDA-null and littermate controls
source_scope: Mouse contusive SCI fibrotic scar
assay_or_perturbation: FnEDA deletion; qPCR/western blot; soluble/matrix fibronectin fractionation; GFAP/axon IHC; BMS and modified BBB scoring
pathway_or_branch: fibronectin-EDA matrix assembly to fibrotic-scar and locomotor phenotype
citation_note: Cooper et al. 2018; FnEDA genetic deletion
evidence_summary: FnEDA deletion altered fibronectin matrix stability and fibrotic-scar anatomy and improved axon-associated and locomotor outcomes.
limitations: No direct integrin/receptor assay or receptor-proximal relay; whole-lesion measurements do not assign a single cell-type mechanism.

source_species_detail: Female Fisher 344 right T10 lateral hemisection with 2-mm cord removal; 15-18 weeks post-injury
source_scope: Chronic rat hemisection scar and cavity
assay_or_perturbation: AFM microindentation; histology; GFAP/tenascin-R/vimentin/myelin IHC; sGAG/O-sulfated GAG assays and HA ELISA
pathway_or_branch: ECM/GAG composition to chronic scar softening and cavitation
citation_note: Baumann et al. 2020; chronic hemisection mechanics
evidence_summary: Chronic scar softening paralleled cavitation, altered CNS-cell content, and dysregulated GAG/HA composition.
limitations: No receptor binding or receptor-proximal signaling assay; fresh-section hemisection mechanics are not directly equivalent to contusion or in-vivo mechanics.

source_species_detail: Female Lister-Hooded and male Wistar rats; C4/T10 dorsal-column crush; DRG sensory neurons
source_scope: Rat sensory SCI and sensory-neuron regeneration
assay_or_perturbation: AAV1 alpha9-integrin plus kindlin-1; controls; tissue clearing/light-sheet; laminin-111/tenascin-C/GFAP/collagen/CSPG staining; cFos/VGLUT; sensory behavior
pathway_or_branch: activated alpha9 integrin/kindlin-1 in laminin/tenascin-C connective bridges to sensory axon regeneration
evidence_summary: Activated alpha9 integrin/kindlin-1 supported axon regeneration through laminin-111/tenascin-C-positive bridges, rostral extension, cFos/VGLUT-associated structures, and sensory recovery.
limitations: No biochemical alpha9beta1-ligand binding or FAK/SRC assay; no alpha9-only group; no motor CST test; matrix localization does not prove direct binding.

source_species_detail: C57BL/6J GlcNAc6ST1/4 double-KO and controls; T10 100-kdyn contusion; myeloid and lesion tissue
source_scope: Mouse SCI and myeloid/ECM tissue
assay_or_perturbation: constitutive double KO; CD11b isolation; IHC; RNA-seq; GO; glycomics; BMS, 5-HT, and white-matter assays
pathway_or_branch: glycan sulfation to ECM/myeloid recruitment and repair phenotype
citation_note: Morozumi et al. 2025; glycan/ECM and SCI recovery study
evidence_summary: Double deficiency reduced monocyte/macrophage accumulation and fibronectin/collagen ECM programs, increased 5-HT fibers and white-matter preservation, and improved BMS recovery.
limitations: No direct receptor-binding or receptor-proximal experiment; constitutive non-cell-specific KO; proposed CD44/hyaluronan and Siglec mechanisms were not tested.

source_species_detail: Leukocyte and endothelial adhesion assays; recombinant PECAM1 and integrin systems
source_scope: PECAM1-alphaVbeta3 heterophilic adhesion
assay_or_perturbation: Recombinant PECAM1; integrin-specific blockade; adhesion assays
evidence_summary: PECAM1 supported alphaVbeta3-dependent heterophilic adhesion.
limitations: Queued receptor ITGB3 is incomplete; alphaVbeta3 complex is required; no SCI or neural model.

source_species_detail: Neutrophils and purified alphaMbeta2
source_scope: uPA-alphaMbeta2 binding and plasminogen activation
assay_or_perturbation: SPR and purified alphaMbeta2 binding; plasminogen activation assay
evidence_summary: uPA bound purified alphaMbeta2 and increased plasminogen activation.
limitations: Queued receptor ITGAM alone is incomplete; alphaMbeta2 complex is required; no SCI or glial validation.

source_species_detail: Contusive SCI; pericytes and infiltrating monocytes/macrophages
source_scope: Recombinant POSTN; Postn knockout; pharmacologic blockade; migration and TNF-alpha assays
assay_or_perturbation: POSTN-associated alphaVbeta3-FAK/Akt macrophage migration and scar relay
evidence_summary: POSTN perturbation altered alphaVbeta3-associated macrophage migration and FAK/Akt-linked scar signaling.
limitations: No purified POSTN-integrin binding or alphaVbeta3-specific necessity test.

source_species_detail: Contusive SCI; pericyte scar model
source_scope: Postn deletion and blockade; scar burden and long-term functional outcome
assay_or_perturbation: POSTN promotes monocyte/macrophage TNF-alpha, pericyte proliferation, and fibrotic scar formation
evidence_summary: POSTN loss reduced fibrotic scar and inflammatory functional outcomes after contusive SCI.
limitations: Functional POSTN phenotype is established; receptor-level mechanism remains incompletely isolated.

source_species_detail: Developing cortical neurons and radial glia
source_scope: Recombinant/native Reelin association; integrin perturbation; migration assays
assay_or_perturbation: Reelin-alpha3beta1 adhesion and neuronal migration relay
evidence_summary: Reelin-associated alpha3beta1 adhesion supported neuronal migration.
limitations: Developmental cortex, not SCI; queued ITGA3 is only one subunit; later genetic studies contest alpha3beta1 requirement.

source_species_detail: Developing cortical neurons
source_scope: Integrin-blocking and deficiency studies; neuronal migration assays
assay_or_perturbation: Reelin-alpha3beta1 modulation of neuron-glia adhesion and Dab1-associated migration
pathway_or_branch: Reelin integrin adhesion and Dab1-associated migration
evidence_summary: Reelin-integrin perturbation altered neuron-glia adhesion and Dab1-associated migration.
limitations: Alpha3beta1 requirement is contested; canonical Reelin receptors remain VLDLR/ApoER2; not SCI.

source_species_detail: Primary neural models and axon-outgrowth assays
source_scope: Recombinant Sema7A; integrin blockade; MAPK and axon-outgrowth assays
assay_or_perturbation: Sema7A-beta1-integrin-dependent MAPK signaling and axon outgrowth
evidence_summary: Sema7A required beta1-integrin-associated signaling for MAPK activation and axon outgrowth.
limitations: Alpha partner was not resolved; no SCI model.

source_species_detail: Recombinant alpha8beta1 and purified osteopontin; K562 adhesion
source_scope: Solid-phase binding and cell adhesion assays
assay_or_perturbation: Spp1 is an alpha8beta1 ligand
evidence_summary: Osteopontin bound alpha8beta1 and supported cell adhesion.
limitations: Kidney/developmental rather than SCI model; queued ITGA8 requires beta1.

source_species_detail: T13 contusion SCI; microglia/macrophage-rich lesion
source_scope: Spp1 knockout; cytokine, tissue-sparing, NeuN, and BMS measurements
assay_or_perturbation: OPN supports inflammatory and tissue-preserving recovery after SCI
evidence_summary: OPN loss altered inflammatory, tissue-sparing, neuronal, and locomotor outcomes after contusion SCI.
limitations: Receptor was not manipulated; SCI phenotype cannot be assigned specifically to alpha8beta1.

source_species_detail: LRP1 ligand-binding domains, LRP1 mini-receptors, and mouse embryonic cortical neurons
source_scope: SPR; LRP1 domain binding; neuronal uptake
assay_or_perturbation: TIMP1 directly binds LRP1 domains II/IV and is internalized
evidence_summary: TIMP1 directly bound LRP1 domains and was internalized in neuronal systems.

assay_or_perturbation: LRP1-mediated TIMP1 signaling alters neuronal outgrowth and growth-cone morphology
evidence_summary: LRP1-dependent TIMP1 exposure altered neurite outgrowth and growth-cone morphology.

source_scope: Alpha9-integrin activation and kindlin-1 perturbation; matrix-bridge and regeneration assays
assay_or_perturbation: Activated alpha9 integrin plus kindlin-1 supports laminin-111/tenascin-C matrix bridges and sensory axon regeneration
evidence_summary: Alpha9-integrin activation and kindlin-1 supported matrix bridges and sensory axon regeneration.

source_species_detail: Contusive SCI; fibrotic scar

evidence_summary: FnEDA deletion altered fibrotic ECM assembly and locomotor outcomes.

assay_or_perturbation: CHAD binds alpha2beta1 and activates MAPK in adherent cells
evidence_summary: Chondroadherin supported alpha2beta1-dependent adhesion and ERK/MAPK activation.
